item.title: H.S. GIRLS BASKETBALL: Storm Warning – Canes reign again as Schuylkill League champions
item.description: A year ago, the Schuylkill Haven Hurricanes’ trophy case was absent of a Schuylkill League girls basketball championship. Now, the Hurricanes have a pair of championships in their trophy case. item.title: H.S. BOYS BASKETBALL: Minersville rallies to win first ever Schuylkill League Championship title over Pottsville
item.description: Minersville stormed back to win the Schuylkill League Championship 47-44 in overtime at Pottsville’s Martz Hall Friday. The Battlin’ Miners (23-1, 13-1) turned up the heat in the second half when they rallied from a seven-point halftime deficit to force overtime.
